role: Self-directed practice engine for mathematical and morphological skills, implementing P1.9-E2 Inflection Practice Mode.
detail: InflectionEngine orchestrates practice problem generation and solving using ProcedureExecutor and MorphologyExecutor. Core classes: PracticeProblem (problem descriptor), PracticeResult (outcome with confidence deltas), PracticeSessionReport (aggregated session metrics). Generates math problems from difficulty ranges (1-3): difficulty 1 uses operands 0-9 with add/subtract; 2 uses 0-20 with add/subtract/multiply; 3 uses 0-50 with all ops. Morphology problems pluralize and inflect base WordFormNodes using ground-truth Python rules (_python_pluralize, _python_past_tense). Key methods: run_practice_session (timed main loop, batches problems, alternates domains, increases difficulty), solve_problem (delegates to _solve_math_problem or _solve_morphology_problem), generate_math_problems/generate_morphology_problems. Validates results against Python ground truth (_MATH_GROUND_TRUTH dict with operators, _MORPHOLOGY_GROUND_TRUTH with transformation functions). Records negative knowledge (DOES_NOT_COMPUTE_TO edges) on mismatches via NegativeKnowledgeManager. Tracks confidence before/after via ACT-R formula using instance_confidence module. Graph integration: queries ValueNodes/WordFormNodes via GraphPersistence, filters by SchemaLevel.INSTANCE, looks up COMPUTES_TO/TRANSFORMS_TO edge confidence. No new procedures created; only exercises existing installed procedures from graph.
gotchas: Fallback behavior: if insufficient ValueNodes exist for math, uses full range (0-9/0-20/0-50). Morphology requires installed WordFormNodes with inflection_type=base; warns and returns empty if none found. Subtract operation swapped to avoid negatives at difficulty<=2. Session report sets math_accuracy/morphology_accuracy to -1.0 if no problems attempted in that domain. Both executors optional; session skips unavailable domains. No formal timeout on problem execution—relies on session-level deadline.
